hypothesis: Two progressively smaller pearls below/right of the upper pearl can establish a deliberate constellation rhythm and connect the isolated upper accent to the crescent.
mutation: Add white held contacts at (820,1000) and (840,1200); reduce them with 40-segment black annuli of path radii 108 and 96 respectively. Preserve existing moon and pearls.
acceptance: Graduated dots must read as an elegant, coherent arc, not clutter; moon tips and silhouette must remain undamaged. Reject if the masking harms the moon or sizes are uneven/unreadable.
